c74object.name: evi.formantosc~
c74object.digest: A classic formant oscillator which can smoothly morph singing voice type and sung vowel sounds for voxy effects.
c74object.description: evi.formantosc~ allows for smoothly interpolating vowels and voices over a fundamental frequency. It gives the classic lofi physical model effect but with many attributes to modify the output and audio rate modulate it for an interesting source.

inlet.description: Fundamental frequency of the vocal chords. Switch between Hz or Pitch input via the 'fundfreqmode' attribute.
Linearly interpolate the singing voice types between Bass..Tenor..CounterTenor..Alto..Soprano. A typical use case would be to attach an X/Y pad to inlets 2 and 3.
Linearly interpolate the vowel formants between A..E..I..O..U. A typical use case would be to attach an X/Y pad to inlets 2 and 3.
Naive reset of the oscillator phase insomuchas it does not antialias and cannot be hard synced. However it might still be useful.

outlet.description: Internal phase zero (one of two internal phases) for external synchronisation tasks.
Internal phase half (one of two internal phases) for external synchronisation tasks.

attribute.name: bwwarp
attribute.description: Multiply (warp) formants bandwidth size. 1 = no warping.

attribute.name: cfwarp
attribute.description: Multiply (warp) formants frequency center. 1 = no warping.

attribute.name: datainterp
attribute.description: Affects the way the maximums (to 1.) are handled for inlets 2 and 3. 0=clip, 1=wrap.

attribute.name: datatype
attribute.description: Affects the way the voice/vowel interpolation sounds (interpolates linear or logarithmic data).

attribute.name: formants
attribute.description: evi.formantosc~ uses 5 measured formants to build an oscillator sound. However with this control you can choose to reduce the number off formants for a thinner (strange) sound. Use the 'formantsoffset' attribute to offset once selected.

attribute.name: formantsoffset
attribute.description: If the 'formants' attribute == 5 this attribute has no effect. If the 'formants' attribute is < 5, this attribute will shift the used formants cyclicly. So if 'formants' == 1, this attribute will shift which formant is sounded. This can have a quirky or ghostly effect. 0 = none, no shifting.

attribute.name: fundfreqmode
attribute.description: Set the input type (units) of the fundamental frequency input. 0 = in Hz, 1 = in Pitch.

attribute.name: gainnorm
attribute.description: 0 respects the physical modelling of the voice, using the gain data to attenuate the formants. 1 ignores the formants data and normalises the gain of all formants. The can make a cool clangourous sound.

attribute.name: gainwarp
attribute.description: Multiply (warp) formants gain amount. 1 = no warping.

attribute.name: highpass
attribute.description: Tame the low end by highpass filtering, almost a DC Block. This can also be important when (audio rate) modulating the oscillator.

attribute.name: paramsmooth
attribute.description: Global internal parameter smoothing in ms.

attribute.name: warpsmooth
attribute.description: Turn off or on the smoothing of the warp parameters ('cfwarp', 'bwwarp', 'gainwarp').

attribute.name: zerophasor
attribute.description: 0 = free running phase updates controlling the oscialltor. 1 = lock phase updates to the changes of the fundamental frequency. Use -1 for FM applications.
